lessons.reason: The exact movie preserves tiled softmax state, rescales both old accumulators, changes actual causal/window/packed support and reconstructs temporary probabilities into gradients without confusing partial mass with the full law. It separates package, return, head/layout, padding, specialization and fallback contracts from hardware measurement. Complete narration and all259 source lines/conditional labels were read. All25 authored sheets plus brand, three registered natives and twelve exact extractions were personally viewed. All438 artifacts/four live-frozen source pairs match. All172 independent actual helper/math/Canvas checks, including central differences, pass; all2409 measured-provider fresh-scene model states have no early result flags. Adjacent movie frames confirm wrong3, intended12 and fallback rejection after separate completed clauses. Short packed-mean restoration and wrong-padding output were independently extracted and verified. No material blocker remains. Long settled dependency/reference panels and schematic physical-page mapping retain honest craft deductions.
